description: Hashes text with SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, SHA-1, MD5 or HMAC, e.g. to sign an API request or check a webhook signature.
label: Hash Text

options.name: algorithm
options.label: Algorithm
options.info: A plain hash (SHA-256 is the usual one), or HMAC to sign with a secret key, e.g. for a webhook or API signature. SHA-1 and MD5 only when another system requires them: they are not secure.

options.name: text
options.label: Text
options.info: The text to hash, exactly as it is: spaces and line breaks change the hash. Hashed as UTF-8 bytes.

options.name: secret-key
options.label: Secret key
options.info: Only for the HMAC algorithms, and required there: the shared secret, used as UTF-8 text. Leave empty for the other algorithms. Use a variable that holds the secret rather than typing it in.

options.name: output-encoding
options.label: Output encoding
options.info: How the hash is written as text. Hex: lowercase, the usual way to write a hash. Base64: standard and padded, which some APIs ask for. Check which one the other system expects.

options.name: hash
options.label: Hash
options.info: The hash of Text in the chosen encoding. In hex: 32 characters for MD5, 40 for SHA-1, 64 for SHA-256, 96 for SHA-384 and 128 for SHA-512 (the same for their HMAC).
